headline: Native vs Cross-Platform in 2026: An Interactive Decision Tool
description: Should you build native, React Native or Flutter in 2026? Use our interactive decision tool to get a recommendation for your app, plus an honest breakdown of cost, speed and performance trade-offs.

itemListElement.name: Native vs Cross-Platform in 2026: An Interactive Decision Tool

mainEntity.name: Is cross-platform development worse than native in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: For the vast majority of apps, no. Modern React Native and Flutter deliver performance and UX that users cannot distinguish from native, from one codebase. Native still wins for apps built around heavy device hardware, advanced graphics or platform-specific capabilities where every millisecond and native API matters.

mainEntity.name: When should I choose native over React Native or Flutter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choose native when the app is defined by hardware or performance: AR, advanced camera or sensor work, high-end games, heavy real-time graphics, or deep platform integrations. Also consider it when you only target one platform and want the absolute best experience on it, and have the budget to build and maintain two codebases if you later add the other.

mainEntity.name: Is React Native cheaper than building native twice?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually, yes. One React Native codebase serves iOS and Android instead of two separate native teams, which is a substantial saving in both build and ongoing maintenance. You trade a small performance margin most apps never notice for speed to market and lower cost.

mainEntity.name: React Native or Flutter — which cross-platform framework is better?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both are excellent. React Native is the natural fit for teams already in JavaScript and React and for apps that share logic with a web product. Flutter shines for highly custom, pixel-perfect and animation-heavy UI. We ship both and choose per project.

mainEntity.name: How do I decide for my specific app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use the interactive decision tool in this article for a recommendation based on your platforms, team, feature needs and stage, then book a free call to pressure-test it against your exact scope.
